title: handle broke off
text: handle broke off. I bought these pot through Bed Bath and Beyond because of a 20% discount.  The handle of one of the pots literally broke off.  Not one of the tops with the short handles but one with the long handle.  I did NOT drop it.  Calphalon told me they would not give me a credit, they would only replace it.  Why would I want another?  Bed Bath and Beyond took it back.  I was surprised but this was not well made at all.
